name: ESO 215-G009 (Hubble)
blurb: ESO 215-G009, an isolated dwarf irregular galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: eso215g009-hubble
story: A faint, isolated dwarf galaxy of old stars, wrapped in a vast cloud of hydrogen gas that reaches more than six times beyond the edge of its starlight.

claims.text: ESO215-G?009 has its optical center at RA 10 57 29.9, Dec -48 10 43 (J2000), matching this pointing (RA 164.3758, Dec -48.1789)
ESO215-G?009 is an isolated dwarf irregular galaxy with an old stellar population and very low surface brightness
Its hydrogen (HI) gas reaches more than six times beyond the edge of its stars (the Holmberg radius)
ESO 215-G?009 is a dwarf irregular galaxy also known as HIPASS J1057-48
